meaning.en: The degree to which something is piquant, stimulating or exciting.
meaning.vi: Mức độ mà điều gì đó gây hứng thú, kích thích hoặc thú vị.

meaning_vi: (nghĩa bóng) sự kích thích; sự khêu gợi ngầm; duyên thầm

sentences.en: The tart flavour of the cranberries adds piquancy.

sentences.en: The production retains its original piquancy.

sentences.en: The situation has an added piquancy since the two men are also rivals in love.

sentences.en: Piquancy was added to the situation because Dr Porter was then on the point of marrying Hugh Miller.

sentences.en: There must therefore have been a certain piquancy for him in now extending hospitality to the fallen monarch.

sentences.en: On this occasion, as an added piquancy, the festival promised to have a distinctly radical flavour.

sentences.en: Their tart flavour adds piquancy and the bright colour looks stunning.
